content.title: Courtyard Status Reversal | Challenge, Charge, Defeat and One-Finger Payoff
content.summary: An adult guild challenger boasts, charges once and ends kneeling before a calm archivist. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: All four characters are clearly adult and positionally stable. + Only one charge and one reversal occur. + The result is shown through posture, not invented dialogue. + Witnesses remain present through the payoff. + The final gesture follows the visible defeat.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place four original adult guild members on one stone archive terrace with clear left-right positions. He performs one bounded forward charge toward the calm archivist; no second attacker enters. The archivist raises one finger and gives one restrained smile while the challenger remains visibly kneeling.
required_anchors: All four characters are clearly adult and positionally stable.
Only one charge and one reversal occur.
Witnesses remain present through the payoff.
The final gesture follows the visible defeat.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult guild challenger boasts, charges once and ends kneeling before a calm archivist. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先在同一庭院建立四名成年角色与对峙轴线；强势男子以表情和冲锋升级威胁，却在一次清楚交锋后跌至跪姿，冷静女子用单指回应完成地位反转，不臆测台词内容。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: All four characters are clearly adult and positionally stable.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "All four characters are clearly adult and positionally stable."

invariants.rule: Only one charge and one reversal occur.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Only one charge and one reversal occur."

invariants.rule: The result is shown through posture, not invented dialogue.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The result is shown through posture, not invented dialogue."

invariants.rule: Witnesses remain present through the payoff.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Witnesses remain present through the payoff."

invariants.rule: The final gesture follows the visible defeat.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final gesture follows the visible defeat."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
